items.name: Statement of purpose (admissions SOP)
items.one_line: A personal essay for university admission that connects past work, the chosen programme and future goals.
items.value_evidence: Many Indian agencies sell SOP writing as a standalone study-abroad service (e.g., SOP Expert, Write Right).

sources.title: SOP Expert (India)
sources.supports: agency selling SOP, LOR and admission-essay writing for university and visa applications

sources.title: Write Right: University SOP writing services (India)
sources.supports: Indian agency selling university SOPs

items.note: Word limits and prompts differ by university and programme; always use the programme's own prompt. Do not confuse with genre:sop_process_doc. Admissions offices increasingly screen for AI-written essays.

items.name: Book or film synopsis
items.one_line: A beginning-to-end summary of a story, including the ending, sent to agents, publishers or producers.
items.value_evidence: Required by agents and producers but rarely commissioned alone; SWA registers synopses as a category, showing Indian writers pitch with them.

sources.title: Jane Friedman: How to Write a Novel or Memoir Synopsis
sources.supports: default synopsis is one or two pages, about 500-1000 words, single spaced, and must reveal the ending

sources.title: Screenwriters Association (India): Script registration guidelines
sources.supports: SWA registers Synopsis, Story, Script, Plot, Screenplay, Dialogue and Song for members, online or at its Mumbai office

items.note: Third person, present tense, reveals the ending. Indian film pitches usually run logline, one-page synopsis, step outline, screenplay.

items.name: AI prompt / system prompt (as a deliverable)
items.one_line: Instructions written for a language model (system prompt, agent brief, reusable prompt template) that make it behave reliably for a task.
items.value_evidence: Anthropic and OpenAI publish prompt-writing guides for this as a craft; sold as a service and on prompt marketplaces.

sources.title: Anthropic docs: Prompt engineering overview
sources.supports: vendor guidance on writing prompts and system prompts

sources.title: OpenAI docs: Prompt engineering
sources.supports: vendor guidance on writing prompts

items.note: Write role, context, task, constraints, output format and examples; test against varied inputs and keep a regression set. For an AI video shot list see genre:ai_video_prompt_script.

items.name: Tagline / slogan
items.one_line: A short line that carries the brand's promise or attitude and survives repetition.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr Business Names & Slogans lists 'Slogan' and 'Tagline' as separate deliverables

sources.title: Fiverr: Business Names & Slogans subcategory
sources.supports: page search data on 2026-10-04: num_found 1233 gigs; filter = Company, Product, Website/App, Slogan, Book/Movie, Tagline; add-ons Domain research, Trademark check, Social media handles

items.note: Tagline = brand-level and long-lived; campaign line = one campaign.

items.name: Talking-head / to-camera script
items.one_line: Script for one person speaking to camera, written in their natural spoken voice with beats for cuts, B-roll and on-screen text.
items.value_evidence: Falls under Upwork's script writer type (2026-01-21) and under ghostwriting of video scripts; no separate facet.

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: Upwork's own list of freelance writing job types with typical hourly rate bands charged on Upwork (blog/web content $15-$35/hr, content writer $15-$40/hr, ghostwriter $20-$45/hr, script writer $30-$56/hr, email & newsletter $15-$40/hr; newswriters $34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor) and project lists per type

items.note: Read it aloud; write contractions and short sentences, and bullet-point mode for presenters who ad-lib.

items.name: Technical blog article (developer content)
items.one_line: Blog article for a technical audience (code walkthrough, architecture explainer, tool comparison) published as marketing content, not product docs.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr's Article type facet lists 'Technical Article' (254 gigs on 2026-10-04); Upwork's technical writer type lists blogs, case studies and how-to guides among projects.

sources.title: Fiverr: Articles & Blog Posts category (Article type facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr's Article type filter with live gig counts, a SUPPLY signal (how many sellers offer it): Long-form article 3494, Informational 3483, Instructional/How-to 3138, News story 1738, Research article 1713, First-person narrative 1507, Listicle 1243, Review 679, Affiliate marketing 323, Opinion piece 280, Technical article 254

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: Upwork's own list of freelance writing job types with typical hourly rate bands charged on Upwork (blog/web content $15-$35/hr, content writer $15-$40/hr, ghostwriter $20-$45/hr, script writer $30-$56/hr, email & newsletter $15-$40/hr; newswriters $34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor) and project lists per type

items.note: Product documentation, API docs and manuals belong to genre_pro_creative (see genre:developer_tutorial, which overlaps); this is the marketing-blog version. Code must run.

items.name: Technical specification / design doc
items.one_line: An engineer's written proposal for how a system will be built, reviewed before code is written.
items.value_evidence: Internal engineering artefact written by the engineers who will build the system; little external paid demand.

sources.title: Design Docs at Google (Malte Ubl)
sources.supports: describes the design-doc practice: context, goals/non-goals, design, alternatives considered, cross-cutting concerns

items.note: Alternatives considered and trade-offs are the heart of it. ADR = one decision per short record (context, decision, consequences).

items.name: TED-style talk
items.one_line: A short idea-led talk built around one idea worth spreading, told through story and evidence.
items.value_evidence: TEDx events run worldwide and speakers hire coaches and writers; TED publishes the format rules.

sources.title: TED: TEDx rules
sources.supports: 'TEDx talks are typically under 18 minutes'; 'Many talks are even shorter, with 3-9 minutes being ideal for a focused idea'

items.note: TEDx rules: talks typically under 18 minutes, with 3-9 minutes ideal for a focused idea. One idea, a throughline, no selling from the stage.

items.name: Telegram channel post
items.one_line: Broadcast post to a Telegram channel's subscribers, typically news, deals, signals or course updates with rich formatting and links.
items.value_evidence: No dedicated marketplace category found on 2026-10-04; written by channel owners or bundled with community management.
items.note: Finance 'tip' channels attract SEBI scrutiny in India; never publish investment advice without registration (see compliance cards).

items.name: Testimonial collection & testimonial page copy
items.one_line: Questions that draw specific customer quotes, and the edited testimonials / reviews page built from them.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr Website Content lists 'Testimonials' and 'Reviews' as page types; AWAI lists 'Testimonial'

sources.title: Fiverr: Website Content subcategory
sources.supports: page search data on 2026-10-04: num_found 4310 gigs; page-type filter = Landing page, Bio/About us, Homepage, Product page, Sales page, Generic content, FAQs, Contact us, Blog post, Privacy policy, Service page, Reviews, Testimonials, Terms & conditions, Press release

sources.title: AWAI: 80 In-Demand Copywriting Projects (updated 2026-02-02)
sources.supports: copywriting pricing guide naming each project type with its own fee guideline; project names checked in the page HTML 2026-10-04

items.note: Edit for clarity only; invented or materially altered testimonials breach consumer law (comp: cards).

items.name: Thesis summary / PhD synopsis
items.one_line: A condensed account of a thesis's problem, method, findings and contribution, required at registration or submission.
items.value_evidence: Required by Indian universities in the PhD process; little open-market demand.
items.note: Format and length are set by each university's ordinance. State the contribution to knowledge explicitly.

items.name: Thought leadership article
items.one_line: Article under an executive's or expert's name that offers a distinctive, defensible point of view on where an industry is going.
items.value_evidence: Upwork's ghostwriting job type lists 'Thought leadership content' among common projects at a $20-$45/hr band (Upwork, 2026-01-21).

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: Upwork's own list of freelance writing job types with typical hourly rate bands charged on Upwork (blog/web content $15-$35/hr, content writer $15-$40/hr, ghostwriter $20-$45/hr, script writer $30-$56/hr, email & newsletter $15-$40/hr; newswriters $34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor) and project lists per type

items.note: Fails when it is generic trend commentary; it needs a claim the named author can defend in a meeting.

items.name: Threads post
items.one_line: Short conversational text post on Meta's Threads, written to start replies rather than to broadcast.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr's social media copywriting Platform facet lists Threads (238 gigs on 2026-10-04).

sources.title: Fiverr: Social Media Copywriting category (Platform facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr's Platform filter with live gig counts, a SUPPLY signal: Instagram 1910, Facebook 1663, LinkedIn 1338, TikTok 1009, Pinterest 376, Threads 238, Snapchat 123, Reddit 96, Twitter 47, Discord 5, Quora 3

items.note: Often cross-posted from X; the native tone is more casual and question-led.

items.name: Topic cluster (spoke) article
items.one_line: Focused article on one subtopic or long-tail query that links up to its pillar page and across to sibling articles.
items.value_evidence: Sold as batches of SEO blog posts; Superpath's community guidance prices a 1200-word B2B SaaS article at $350-$700 (2022, dated).

sources.title: Superpath: How to work with freelance writers: rates, relationships and sourcing (2022-10-11)
sources.supports: Superpath community guidance that a 1200-word B2B SaaS article should cost $350-$700, with flat fees per project the norm in B2B (dated 2022, medium confidence)

items.note: Must target an intent the pillar does not already answer, or the two pages cannibalise each other.

items.name: Topical / moment-marketing ad
items.one_line: Fast brand reaction to news, a match or a festival, built on one witty line plus the brand.
items.value_evidence: Indian agency social retainers routinely include topicals (qualitative; no market list found)
items.note: India-specific staple (Amul-style). Unsure if this is ad or organic social; merge may move it to genre_content.

items.name: Trade show / exhibition materials
items.one_line: Booth graphics lines, standees, handouts and demo scripts for expos and exhibitions.
items.value_evidence: AWAI lists 'Trade Show Materials' as a project type

sources.title: AWAI: 80 In-Demand Copywriting Projects (updated 2026-02-02)
sources.supports: copywriting pricing guide naming each project type with its own fee guideline; project names checked in the page HTML 2026-10-04

items.note: Booth lines must read from a distance, like OOH.

items.name: Transactional email copy
items.one_line: Order confirmations, receipts, password resets and shipping updates written to be clear and on-brand.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr Email Copy lists 'Transactional emails' as an email type

sources.title: Fiverr: Email Copy subcategory
sources.supports: page search data on 2026-10-04: num_found 1782 gigs; email-type filter = Welcome emails, Lead generation/Cold emailing, Newsletters, Email Sequences, Special offers, New product announcement, Follow-Up Emails, Transactional emails, Curated content, Internal updates, Fundraising Emails

items.note: Clarity first; adding marketing content to a transactional message can change how the law treats it (check comp: cards).

items.name: Travel guide / itinerary post
items.one_line: Destination article (itinerary, where to stay, what to eat, costs, how to get there) written from first-hand travel.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr's article Topic facet lists Travel & hospitality (316 gigs on 2026-10-04).

sources.supports: Fiverr's Article type filter with live gig counts, a SUPPLY signal (how many sellers offer it): Long-form article 3494, Informational 3483, Instructional/How-to 3138, News story 1738, Research article 1713, First-person narrative 1507, Listicle 1243, Review 679, Affiliate marketing 323, Opinion piece 280, Technical article 254

items.note: Prices, timings and visa rules date fast; show a 'last checked' date.

items.name: Troubleshooting guide
items.one_line: A symptom-to-fix guide that lets a user or support agent diagnose and resolve a known problem without escalation.
items.value_evidence: Part of technical-writing work on manuals and how-to guides (Upwork technical-writer projects).

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: technical writers produce manuals and how-to guides

items.note: Organise by symptom the user sees (exact error text), then likely cause, then fix steps, then 'if that did not work'. Most common cause first.

items.name: TV / OTT / CTV commercial script (TVC)
items.one_line: Shot-by-shot script for a broadcast or streaming TV spot: visuals, VO, supers and sound, to a fixed duration.
items.value_evidence: AWAI's 2026 pricing guide lists 'TV Commercial Script'; Fiverr Video Script sub-subcategory covers ads and commercials; Indian agencies sell ad film scripts
